articles.description: The update to Waymo's self-driving system was rolled out nearly a year ago.

points: Waymo released a software update to correct illegal passing behavior nearly a year ago.
Federal investigators are scrutinizing Waymo's self-driving cars for illegal passing incidents.
Waymo plans to expand its robotaxi service nationwide next year.
articles.insight: This news highlights the challenges of ensuring public safety with self-driving vehicles and the importance of continued monitoring and improvements in software updates.

articles.title: Musk says Tesla will refund some Cybertruck deposits, defends decision to end production
articles.description: Elon Musk defended the company's decision to stop making the Cybertruck, which will go out of production in around 8 months.
articles.summary: Elon Musk defended Tesla'thy decision to stop production of the Cybertruck. Musk also announced a partial refund for customers who have deposited money for the vehicle, as the company faces delays. Tesla plans to focus on the Cybertruck's final touches and start production after resolving the issues, which will take about 8 more months.
points: Tesla to partially refund Cybertruck deposits due to production delays.
Musk defends decision to halt Cybertruck production; delays expected to take 8 months.
Focus on final touches for Cybertruck, production to resume post-issue resolution.
articles.insight: The halting of the Cybertruck production and refund plan indicates Tesla's commitment to quality and customer satisfaction despite facing setbacks. This situation also highlights the importance of risk management and transparency in the tech industry.

articles.title: Tesla expands robotaxi service to San Antonio
articles.description: This will be the fourth Texas city in which Tesla will launch robotaxis.
articles.summary: Tesla has announced the expansion of its robotaxi service to San Antonio, Texas, making it the fourth city in the state where the service is offered. Tesla'selimited service allows for pre-booking rides with its self-driving technology. This move by Tesla is part of a broader initiative to scale up its autonomous driving capabilities.
points: Tesla's robotaxi service is expanding to San Antonio, Texas.
Only registered Tesla owners can pre-book rides for $2/mile.
The service currently operates in Fremont, California, Texas, and Miami, Florida, and is part of Tesla's initiative to scale up autonomous driving.
articles.insight: Tesla's expansion of its robotaxi service in San Antonio represents a significant step towards the widespread adoption of self-driving technology in the public transportation sector, potentially disrupting traditional taxi services.
